raw:
I remember being by my garden chair with wasps swarming right beside it. There was a nest inside a hollow stump, and having so many of them that close was frightening. I was trying to keep track of where they were, but then one landed on my shirt collar.

That was the part that really scared me. It was so close to my neck, and I didn’t know whether moving would make it sting me. I wanted to get away, but I was afraid to make a sudden movement. My attention narrowed down to that one wasp on my collar, even with all the others flying nearby.
